This route was significant as it facilitated trade between the two regions, contributing to the economic growth of the Islamic empire.

Asreen was also the name of a major battle fought between the Muslim forces of Caliph Umar ibn Abdulaziz and the Marwani dynasty in the late 8th century. The battle took place near the city of Sakastan in present-day Iran, and marked the end of the Umayyad Caliphate and the beginning of the Abbasid Caliphate.
